lines: Bhavya Kapoor, an Investor Selling Shareholder, may sell up to 4,500 shares in the offer for sale, bringing up to ₹0.61 crore, if all offered shares are sold.
Estimated gain is up to ₹0.45 crore, before offer expenses and taxes, and the employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Timing: the money is in hand since listing (trading started March 11, 2026), and the retained stake is an estimate of ₹1.42 crore at offer price.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in only one section (promoter_holding).
